title: Change Log
intro: The recorded history of the Michael Lane edition, from 28 October 2026. Related iterations are grouped into user-facing changes. Dates describe development; public build numbers identify published milestones. Original Lemon Studio development predates this edition.

sections.title: Lemon Chop, pitch and workflow · public build 2026110203
changes: Added Lemon Chop, a separate slicing instrument with cue pads, automatic slicing, editable cue regions, pad names/favorites, reverse, pitch/stretch controls and undo/redo.
Integrated optional local stem separation into Chop, with selectable stem mixes and source-region export; saved Chop state reopens with the project.
Added Chop to Instruments / Sampler for existing and new profiles without duplicate entries after rescans.
Fixed loading audio into Chop from the sample browser, plugin frame and Explorer drops; reloading the same source refreshes analysis.
Added a searchable visual plugin picker with favorites, real editor previews and instrument/effect filtering appropriate to the destination.
Added cancellable automatic plugin preview capture on Windows, with isolated helpers, progress, timeouts and cached results.
Simplified channel rack context menus and added direct access to the instrument picker.
Moved Global Pitch to compact channel rack controls; added per-channel pitch ranges and a global-follow switch that preserves pitch when toggled.
Added master tape-style Varispeed, changing pitch and duration together for the complete mix and exports.
Added reversible channel Consolidate / Bounce to Audio, including an effects-rendered option and a keep-mixer-live option; preserves the muted original and provides undo.
Added actual waveform previews for bounced audio in the channel rack.
Added Scale Notes Only to the piano roll for all 22 scales and 12 roots; out-of-scale MIDI is preserved and returns when filtering is disabled.
Fixed playback continuity while trimming audio clips and made resize edges take priority over clip-body actions.
Fixed non-Windows compilation of the preview helper. Windows, Linux x64 and Apple-silicon Mac packages were published as 2026110203; preparation build 2026110202 was not published.

sections.title: ARA, community and browser · public build 2026110201
changes: Added source-based ARA 2 editor integration, playback and project archives for compatible audio editors.
Added host-frame resizing for resizable VST3 editors and isolated ARA diagnostics.
Known issues: Auto-Tune Pro 11 ARA compatibility and Melodyne transport behavior remain unresolved; ARA support does not imply every editor works correctly.
Added Community forum beside Voting, with threads, replies, likes/dislikes, optional display names and profile pictures.
Grouped feature suggestions into Active voting, Planned, In progress, Completed, Rejected and Voting closed; closed suggestions retain their history.
Added forum moderation and administrator profiles, posting and replies through the owner dashboard.
Improved browser refresh and sample preview gestures; restored mixer Alt-click EQ reset.
Placed multiple imported samples on available Playlist tracks instead of stacking them on the same occupied row.
Added 18 verified direct-download plugin entries, bringing the curated catalog to 93 entries.
Published Windows, Linux x64 and Apple-silicon Mac build 2026110201.

sections.title: Community, instruments and editing
changes: Added the Plugin Downloads browser with a curated catalog, preview images, hover cards and supported portable installation; expanded the catalog with 25 directly downloadable freeware plugins.
Added shared feature voting with anonymous identities, one vote per idea, changing votes, search and offline cached reading.
Added public suggestion statuses, owner comments and announcements, plus a protected owner moderation dashboard.
Added an independent STRIP bypass switch and compact temporary EQ/low-cut/gate value readouts.
Added reversible Playlist instrument Freeze / Unfreeze and independent track Bounce; fixed assigned-track bounce rendering.
Added Quick Sidechain and expandable, scrolling mixer effect slots.
Added monitor-only headphone correction with searchable AutoEq profiles; correction stays out of exports.
Added a miniature mixer routing picker to sample controls and clip menus; fixed macOS picker focus.
Added opt-in local AI control with an authenticated control interface.
Separated development and production profiles and their sample libraries; fresh public profiles no longer inherit personal library paths.
Added optional Lemon Studio Starter Pack installation and an empty sample-library starting point.
Made fresh launches show the mixer above the Playlist.
Adopted .lmn as the native project extension while preserving supported existing project opening.
Fixed common editing shortcuts and routed keys to the focused editor.
Enabled piano-roll Ctrl-click and marquee selection with any note tool; repaired MIDI drops, controller import and event editing.
Kept audio comp edits independent from automation cuts.
Fixed ASIO monitoring continuity using driver-owned buffers and preserved input across very small callback batches.
Separated and right-aligned application window controls; improved toolbar hints and repainting of mixer values.
Added traditional mixer layouts, clearer section separators and recovery of plugin title bars.
Simplified mixer view choices, added a browser audition panel and Playlist waveform-detail controls.
Restored Playlist tool buttons and organized working Piano Roll options.
Public builds 2026110101–2026110106 followed these updates during the day; later mixer/browser changes were included in the 2 November release.

sections.title: Mixing, stems and cross-platform downloads
changes: Added vocal SnapTune pitch correction with an explicit bypass switch, manual key/scale and voice range, plus Learn key suggestions.
Added Follow audio level / Duck linking for supported native and hosted parameters, with source, depth and release controls.
Added independent Stereo / Mid / Side / Left / Right processing per EQ band, saved with project and A/B state.
Added signed automatic Windows updates, an Updates control and a compact Donate link; added the Michael Lane edition startup label.
Opened the common download page with Windows, Linux and Mac downloads and matching source archives.
Added the shared source/build workflow and native Apple-silicon Mac packaging; published cross-platform build 2026103103.
Added compact dedicated mixer EQ with a spectrum display, Pre/Post routing and independent tone controls.
Kept dedicated EQ active when plugin Effects slots are bypassed; EQ retains its own enable control.
Added mouse-wheel EQ band-width editing and improved Master navigation-button spacing.
Defaulted imported samples to Master without moving mixer selection when sample settings open.
Restored optional browser tabs through the browser menu; added configurable auto-hide, off by default.
Strengthened Tame resonance reduction while retaining stereo linkage and transient handling.
Made every fader in fresh template sessions start at unity without changing saved-song mixes or marking a fresh session modified.
Set fresh mixer Effects defaults off, retained enabled FX returns, and allowed Playlist track families to move together.
Improved EQ unit labels, continuous knob scaling, vocal-strip alignment and spacing around faders and controls.
Added separate editable instrument/effect folder databases and cascading nested plugin menus; fixed application close behavior over open menus.
Added optional local stem separation with on-demand runtime setup and a choice of individual stems or combinations to save/add.
Fixed pattern click selection, VST3 note releases and channel-rack submenu anchoring.
Added compact mixer view and kept recording in the selected pattern.
Added Make Unique with undo for chopped audio clips.
Added signed automatic updates for Mac and Linux; older versions need one manual updater-enabled installation.
Published builds 2026103104 and 2026103105 as the day’s later updates were packaged. Linux was compiled and packaged; Linux runtime/audio testing was not performed.

sections.title: Vocal controls and workspace
changes: Added vocal-only DeBess processing.
Fixed personal sample-library browsing.
Added independent plugin editor windows for multi-monitor workflows.
Added explicit mixer channel layouts and improved compact-control alignment.
Simplified mixer channel context menus and improved mixer navigation spacing.
Changed sound-shaping defaults to neutral settings.

sections.title: Recording, comping and audio workflow
changes: Added recursive browser search and nested plugin folders; expanded the starter templates with FX-send layouts.
Added joined window dividers, browser reflow and resize-edge snapping.
Improved Windows startup visibility and added a completion chime.
Added Tap tempo through the BPM context menu.
Added mixer section jump buttons, restored centered FX bypass and refined recording-arm/FX placement.
Improved mixer visual spacing and made native strip controls respond consistently to drags.
Moved Low Cut and Gate before Drive; added Tube, Tape, Soft and Clip drive styles with saved state and undo.
Simplified fixed Master controls and repositioned All Effects.
Implemented 16-point sinc live sample interpolation and a 512-point offline-export default; replaced misleading audio-settings placeholders with descriptions of implemented behavior.
Added non-destructive audio take lanes and comping, retaining original takes with saved comp selections and undo/redo.
Added a direct Comp tool and overlap-triggered take lanes; improved the compact Playlist header and live audio-clip editing.
Turned typing-keyboard note input off at startup and kept subsequent recordings on the same track.
Fixed Playlist startup origin, improved vertical zoom-handle behavior and bounded monitoring backlog during playback transitions.
Smoothed recording transitions and added independent take solo.
Improved mixer dragging, established native public defaults and prepared the Windows installer and Mac source handoff.

sections.title: Michael Lane edition begins
changes: Established this customized edition from the existing Lemon Studio project; the original project predates this changelog.
Added a native starter-template workflow, template names for new sessions and mixer-first startup; repaired Windows settings-folder handling and installed factory-template support.
Simplified the toolbar and Playlist editing controls; moved the mixer plugin inspector to the left and improved plugin categories and scrolling.
Added Samples and Favorites browsing with persistent favorites and sample preview/drag support.
Set B to the normal editing pointer, C to Slice and E to Select; Ctrl temporarily selects, and Escape closes the front window while retaining the Playlist.
Added Make it fit length choices, source tempo analysis, pitch-preserving stretching and transparent audio clips.
Fixed fitting drift for active sampler voices and made explicit fitting use live Stretch Pro timing.
Added mixer-input recording and live monitoring through the actual mixer, effects, buses and Master; later expanded to simultaneous input recording.
Added automatic MIDI/automation capture when Record is enabled and no mixer audio input is armed.
Added independent mixer-chain multi-core processing.
Fixed Waves editor loading with Unicode paths.
Added slim stereo meters, analog VU options, clearer strip borders, color accents and per-channel/global Effects bypass.
Added native mixer strip processing, meter switching, Alt-click resets and window edge snapping; removed redundant mixer controls.
Added linked transparent automation overlays with curve selection and a separate visibility switch.
Added automation targets for native strip controls, sends and slot mix, with saved baselines and Return to original value.
Added sampler-to-mixer routing drag with Playlist name/color adoption and undo.
Combined the toolbar into a single row and added global pitch automation.
Added one-shot automation capture for the next moved supported control.
Added mixer boundary insertion and channel copy/paste including processing and outgoing routes; retargeted automation when channels move.
Added grouped mixer faders and improved instrument MIDI recording, arm-only recording and later MIDI continuation.
Improved piano-roll slice priority and added a native harmony/chord workspace with Simple/Complex views and hosted instrument preview.
Expanded the native mixer strip and refined Tame resonance control.
